panel.trimTip: Trim entities by change count — drag the low thumb up to hide barely-tracked items and focus the busiest journeys.

help.title: Entity journeys — how to read them

grid.title: The grid
items: Each **row** is a tracked thing (item · faction · …); **columns** are scenes in reading order.
The **bands** group scenes into chapters — a thing's changes are accumulated per chapter, like a character's.
A band's **dots** are the changes in that chapter, colored by direction; click a row to read the journey.

moved.title: How it moved (every change is one of four)

rows.● shift: a lateral move — changes hands, is altered, realigns
rows.● reveal: it becomes known — exposed or discovered

facet.title: What changed (the facet)
items: Facets are **per category**: an item moves along custody · state · location · function; a faction along power · standing · allegiance · territory.
Only **arc-worthy** things get journeys: it has a world page, recurs across scenes, or the analysis flagged it major.

provenance.title: Provenance
items: The journey is the analysis agent's reading of the scenes — its understanding, not authored truth. Re-running analysis refreshes it.
